note: Draft vectors for LIP-0022. No vector reads a node or a clock: tips, times, heights and the state of nodes are stated. Block hashes are placeholders. A vector whose outcome is not the passing one holds one defect and names a neighbour with the passing outcome that differs from it in that defect; a vector marked compound states several findings and names none. No verdict of this file records a closure. S, LAG and K are the proposed values of three provisional numbers; a change of one of them changes the vectors at its boundary.

fields.observations: readings: the tips of the first and of the last read, the hash that the node gives for height 0, and where stated the tip read before the effect. facts: a block that holds a fact, and what the node gives for heights of its active chain.
fields.nodes: active_chain of the reading node maps a height to the hash that the node gives for it. headers_above_tip is how many blocks the best header that a node knows lies above its tip.
fields.clock: now, kept_mark and tip_header_time are seconds of UTC. class is absent where the action profile states none. now_before_effect is the second reading of B1.6.
fields.recent: blocks: committed_block_height is absent where the node does not know the committed hash. windows: the rule of LIP-0008 section 7.1 with a verdict and no code.
fields.depth: evidence.block_height is absent for a pending transaction.
fields.order: findings lists the codes that hold for one observation, in no particular order; expect is the one that B6.1 reports.

rules.title: an observation between two reads of the tip
a void observation proves nothing and closes nothing
rules.not_covered: No vector holds a closure. The vectors of B1.1 state the void observation.

rules.title: the pinned chain
a confirmed fact belongs to the observation
every fact of a check from one observation
rules.not_covered: The window vectors take the height of the tip from one observation. No vector holds a whole admission check, and none shows a fact from an earlier observation.

rules.title: the tip and the clock again before an effect
the reading node and a comparison node
rules.not_covered: node-07 states a verifier without a comparison node. No vector shows that a fact was taken from one.

rules.title: when two nodes count as two
a healthy node
when tips agree
a healthy observation
the verifier's clock
rules.not_covered: No vector reads a clock; each states a reading.

rules.title: a clock that went back
a header ahead of the clock
the age of the tip
the class of an action
the two cutoffs
the issuer commits the tip of its observation
rules.not_covered: No vector holds an issuer's observation.

rules.title: the recent block on the active chain
the anchor above the recent block
after a reorganisation
the depth of a confirmed fact
the larger of the signed minimum and the operator's floor
no comparison across chains
the order of the first six codes
the place of the other three
rules.not_covered: No vector holds a rule of a grant beside a refusal of this profile.

readings.claim: The first and the last read give the same tip, and the block of height 0 has the pinned hash.
A block arrived during the reads: the last read gives a higher tip.
The tip was replaced during the reads: the same height, another hash.
The node gives another hash for the block of height 0: it is on another chain.
The tip that the verifier reads immediately before the effect is the tip of the observation.
A block arrived between the observation and the effect.

A fact in the tip block itself.
The block is known and is not on the active chain: the node gives another hash for its height.
The stated height of the block is above the tip.
The block is on the active chain and does not hold the transaction.

The comparison node is one block behind and on another branch: the reading node gives another hash for that height.
The only comparison node has the source label of the reading node: two addresses of one source count as one node.
Two comparison nodes agree. One has the reading node's label and does not count; the other has another label and does.
The comparison node is in initial block download.
The comparison node does not answer.
The comparison node is on another chain: it gives another hash for the block of height 0.
The reading node is in initial block download.
The reading node knows a header one block above its tip, which the proposed LAG allows.
The reading node knows a header two blocks above its tip.
Two comparison nodes of other sources: one does not answer, the other is healthy and agrees.
Two healthy comparison nodes of other sources: one is on another branch, the other agrees. One that agrees is enough.

depth.claim: A fact in the tip block has depth 1, which meets a minimum of 1.
The grant signs a minimum of 3 and the operator's floor is 6: the minimum that holds is 6, and the evidence has depth 6.
The same minimums with evidence of depth 5. A checker that took the smaller of the two would admit.

The same minimums with evidence of depth 5: a configuration does not lower the signed minimum.
The evidence is a pending transaction, which has no depth.
The minimum is for evidence on Namecoin, and the evidence offered is 100 blocks deep on another chain.
